2) Load and prepare data

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report, confusion_matrix
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load
df = pd.read_csv("matches.csv", parse_dates=["Date"])

# Basic target: FTR (H/D/A)
df = df.dropna(subset=["HomeTeam", "AwayTeam", "FTHG", "FTAG", "FTR"])
df["target"] = df["FTR"]

# Feature engineering: simple, transparent features
# 1) Recent form: for each team, compute rolling average goals scored and conceded in last N matches before current match.
N = 5

# Ensure matches sorted by date
df = df.sort_values("Date").reset_index(drop=True)

# Helper to compute rolling stats per team
def add_rolling(df, team_col, goals_for_col, goals_against_col, prefix):
    df_out = df.copy()
    df_out[f"{prefix}_scored"] = np.nan
    df_out[f"{prefix}_conceded"] = np.nan
    last_matches = {}
    for i, row in df_out.iterrows():
        date = row["Date"]
        team = row[team_col]
        # get previous recorded matches for this team
        history = last_matches.get(team, [])
        if len(history) > 0:
            recent = pd.DataFrame(history)
            df_out.at[i, f"{prefix}_scored"] = recent[goals_for_col].tail(N).mean()
            df_out.at[i, f"{prefix}_conceded"] = recent[goals_against_col].tail(N).mean()
        else:
            df_out.at[i, f"{prefix}_scored"] = np.nan
            df_out.at[i, f"{prefix}_conceded"] = np.nan
        # after recording, append this match outcome for team
        last_matches.setdefault(team, []).append({goals_for_col: row[goals_for_col], goals_against_col: row[goals_against_col]})
    return df_out

# Prepare a long-form dataframe to compute per-team stats, then merge back
# Create rows for home team and away team perspectives
home = df[["Date","HomeTeam","FTHG","FTAG"]].rename(columns={"HomeTeam":"Team","FTHG":"goals_for","FTAG":"goals_against"})
away = df[["Date","AwayTeam","FTAG","FTHG"]].rename(columns={"AwayTeam":"Team","FTAG":"goals_for","FTHG":"goals_against"})
long = pd.concat([home, away], ignore_index=True).sort_values("Date").reset_index(drop=True)
long = add_rolling(long, "Team", "goals_for", "goals_against", "recent")
# Split back into home/away features and merge
home_feats = long.iloc[::2].reset_index(drop=True)[["recent_scored","recent_conceded"]].rename(columns={"recent_scored":"home_recent_scored","recent_conceded":"home_recent_conceded"})
away_feats = long.iloc[1::2].reset_index(drop=True)[["recent_scored","recent_conceded"]].rename(columns={"recent_scored":"away_recent_scored","recent_conceded":"away_recent_conceded"})

df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
df = pd.concat([df, home_feats, away_feats], axis=1)

# Additional simple features
df["home_recent_scored"].fillna(df["home_recent_scored"].mean(), inplace=True)
df["away_recent_scored"].fillna(df["away_recent_scored"].mean(), inplace=True)
df["home_recent_conceded"].fillna(df["home_recent_conceded"].mean(), inplace=True)
df["away_recent_conceded"].fillna(df["away_recent_conceded"].mean(), inplace=True)

df["diff_recent_scored"] = df["home_recent_scored"] - df["away_recent_scored"]
df["diff_recent_conceded"] = df["home_recent_conceded"] - df["away_recent_conceded"]
df["is_home"] = 1  # all matches are home:feature indicates perspective

features = ["diff_recent_scored","diff_recent_conceded"]
X = df[features].values
y = df["target"].values

# Encode target
le = LabelEncoder()
y_enc = le.fit_transform(y)  # H/D/A -> 0/1/2 for example

3) Train/test split and model training
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y_enc, test_size=0.2, stratify=y_enc, random_state=42)

clf = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42)
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

4) Evaluation
y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)
print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred, target_names=le.classes_))
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test, y_pred)
sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt="d", xticklabels=le.classes_, yticklabels=le.classes_)
plt.xlabel("Predicted"); plt.ylabel("True"); plt.title("Confusion matrix"); plt.show()

5) Interpretation and good practices (educational)
- Use time-aware splits for realistic evaluation: when predicting future matches, train on earlier seasons and test on later ones rather than random splits.
- Be careful with data leakage: do not use information from the future (post-match stats) when constructing features.
- Calibrate class probabilities if you need probabilistic outputs; assess calibration with reliability plots.
- Evaluate different algorithms, baseline models (e.g., always-predict-most-common, simple Poisson models for goal counts), and use cross-validation over time folds (e.g., rolling-window).
